name: Hamed Niroomand
title: Senior Frontend Engineer · Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript
tagline: I build TypeScript frontends and treat every product like it is my own.
summary: Senior frontend engineer with 7+ years of hands-on work in Vue, Nuxt and TypeScript. I spent the last four and a half years at Jack Westin, a US EdTech platform with 500K+ registered accounts, building server-rendered Nuxt apps and caring about the parts users and search engines actually feel: SSR and hydration, Core Web Vitals, SEO and accessibility. Most recently I migrated a production section from Nuxt 2 to Nuxt 4 and took its Lighthouse performance score from 36 to 97. I also led the five-person frontend team there for four years while staying in the code, so code review, mentoring and working directly with product and backend are routine for me. At Thales MFI I built a real-time crypto portfolio product on my own, from the first commit to production, and kept it running for two years.
description: Senior frontend engineer, 7+ years of Vue, Nuxt and TypeScript in production. This resume has a terminal. Type help.
